sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include enalapril maleate as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 507 tablets of the 10 mg presentation at a daily use of 11.4 tablets, providing 44.4 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 262 tablets of the 10 mg presentation at a daily use of 14 tablets, providing 18.8 days on hand.
The ranked alternate manufacturer is Amici Pharma, Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no plant we could place.
A label for Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407) shows a registered plant with a most recent VAI inspection ending 2026-07-16.
Buyer should verify current supply commitments with Amici Pharma, Inc. and monitor the Bryant Ranch Prepack plant inspection history for any change in classification.
